notes.title: 1st anniversary with new functions!!
notes.content: [p]On 29th Aug 2025, A-Rabbit celebrates its 1st anniversary![/p][p]Thank you for finding, and playing the game![/p][p][/p][p]New functions are celebrating its anniversary![/p][p][/p][h3]1. 1-Button operation[/h3][p]Now you can play the game only 1-button "Space!"[/p][p]Stopping order can modify from settings.[/p][p][/p][h3]2. Force flag function[/h3][p]Get the bonus at any time you want. You can make force flag from settings![/p][p]Note) Status will not be saved when use force flag function.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080300/d129316af3c4aa23c3b8130a0b2c580ea5089f04.png"][/img][/p][p]Hope you keep enjoying it![/p]

notes.title: Thank you for 2,000 Downloads!!
notes.content:
On 2nd May 2025, A-Rabbit has achieved 2,000 downloads!
There are also 40 reviews, including from overseas, getting many thumbs-up reactions!
Furthermore, we have no day not be launched the game around the world.
Thank you for playing to all users! And we are developing a new machine, slowly but steadily.

It is really appreciate sharing your favorite pattern in A-Rabbit!
Screen shot of main screen, the shot of bonus history and text explanation are all welcomed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080300/df5accbf74a9b849cbbf75f32daa3ba435d56b6f.jpg[/img]
This is my favorite pattern that implies BONUS by stopped 2 reels.


Enjoy!

sin spark

notes.title: Thank you for 1,500 Downloads!!
notes.content:
On 24th December 2024, A-Rabbit has now achieved 1,500 downloads in 4 month!
We can't believe it, and we're really happy for the achievement!

At first, we think there are a few downloads from overseas.
But total downloads of 30% are from overseas. Thank you for finding the game!
It is so excited to spread the of the Japanese style slot machine!

We're planing a new machine now!
We appreciate for your support and waiting for next machine!

sin spark

notes.title: V1.10 Update on 21st October
notes.content:
[h1]Multi save data, resetting and random setting are now available![/h1]
We add functions of those with player's request!
You can now play with setting prediction using random setting and save data!

Note: Lucky Ptns. will be shared all save data.

notes.title: Thank you for 1,000 Downloads!!
notes.content:
Our App "A-Rabbit," released in August 28th 2024, has now achieved to 1,000 downloads in total of all platforms with a month!

As we released this app, our goal was 500 downloads.
But now it grows twice of first estimation because your grateful support!

There are many small techniques, or little effect laws, to make the game more enjoyable!
We'll add our official guide furthermore to help you reaching!

Please take a look the guide and your play history, and you'll notice more things and get exciting!
We hope you spending amazing time with "A-Rabbit" for a long time!

sin spark

notes.title: V1.01b Minor Update on 18th September
notes.content:
[h1]Enjoy playing A-Rabbit on Mac OS![/h1]
A-Rabbit is now available not only on Windows but also Mac OS.
It is also adapted x-platform link for steam cloud. Please have fun by your favorite platform!

It is included minor bug fix.

notes.title: V1.01 Minor Update on 5th September
notes.content:
[h1]How to is extended regarding effect rules and RT.[/h1]
You can check extra explanation from how to on the menu.

[h1]Add "Show slip count" settings.[/h1]
You can see slip count lively. Check settings on the menu to activate.
